name: carnet-audition-assistant-pv
description: Carnet d'audition mobile professionnel : interface terrain moderne, audio + texte, correction locale, export .pvaud et transfert direct sécurisé vers Assistant PV sur le réseau local.

scripts.android:add: npx cap add android && node scripts/install-native-recorder.js && node scripts/install-whisper-engine.js && node scripts/install-app-icon.js
scripts.android:sync: npx cap sync android && node scripts/install-native-recorder.js && node scripts/install-whisper-engine.js && node scripts/install-app-icon.js
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
